blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine women’s football team was placed in a tough draw for the AFC Women’s Olympic Qualifying Tournament that will be played across three windows starting in April 2027. The Filipinas will be facing North Korea, South Korea and China in Group B, which was determined following Thursday’s draw ceremony at the AFC House in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. READ: From Asian Games to World Cup, Filipinas in for tough buildup Under the new qualification format, the Filipinas are set to play a home-and-away format, where they will face the fancied sides twice in April, October and November.
